profile.reading:
Bitviking is a business address at Via Leopoldo Camillo Volta 5a in the Valletta Valsecchi district of Mantova, in Lombardy, northern Italy. The map record describes it in Italian as blockchain and mining solutions. It is carried in this registry as a data centre, and the map history shows exactly how that happened and why the classification should be treated as weak.

The OpenStreetMap node was created on 29 September 2019 by a contributor mapping businesses that accept cryptocurrency, using the Level0 editor, with the changeset comment bitcoin merchant. The original tags described an information technology office that accepted bitcoin payment, with the description blockchain and mining solutions, the street address and a website. There was no data centre tag at all. In July 2023 another mapper modernised the payment tagging to the currency scheme with a survey date of 18 July 2023. Then on 17 October 2023 a contributor working on the BTC Map project, in a single object edit tagged with the btcmap hashtag and the comment add amenity, added telecom=data_center. A later Italian address normalisation edit tidied the house number. So the data centre classification was applied four years after the point was created, by a mapper adding a category to a bitcoin merchant listing, and it has never been checked against the premises.

The operator's own web presence, which is the tag the original mapper did record, is now out of service. The apex domain bitviking.it resolves but serves only a frameset pointing at the courtesy page of the Italian registrar Register.it, the placeholder shown for a registered domain with no live site behind it. The www hostname resolves to a host that presents a wildcard certificate for a hosted application platform which does not match the name, so it does not load either. No company page, service description, registration detail or trading status could be retrieved this session.

The address itself argues against a mining or hosting plant. Via Leopoldo Camillo Volta 5a is a numbered street address in a residential and mixed use quarter of a historic city of about 50,000 people, not an industrial estate, a substation site or a former factory of the kind cryptocurrency mining takes over for its power connection. What the record best supports is an office of a small blockchain and mining services business, quite possibly a reseller or consultancy rather than an operator of racks. This registry publishes no floor area, no power figure and no equipment count for it, and does not treat it as capacity.
profile.research_note: Rewritten 2026-09-05 from 1,141 characters of name based speculation to a documented tagging chain. Full OSM history retrieved this pass: node 6835335762 v1 2019-09-29 by user quibitcoin in changeset 75066664 (Level0, comment Bitcoin merchant) tagged office=it, payment:bitcoin=yes, description Soluzioni blockchain e mining, website https://www.bitviking.it, address Via Leopoldo Camillo Volta 5/A Mantova 46100, with NO telecom tag. v2 and v3 on 2023-07-18 by mapper saunter migrated payment:bitcoin to currency:XBT with check_date. v4 on 2023-10-17 by Igor Bubelov in changeset 142690956, a single object edit with hashtag #btcmap and comment Add amenity, added telecom=data_center. v5 2023-11-17 by an Italian toponymy account normalised the house number to 5a. Site status verified directly: http://bitviking.it returns an 805 byte frameset pointing at courtesy.register.it, the Register.it parked domain courtesy page, and www.bitviking.it presents a wildcard certificate for odoo.com that does not match the hostname, so neither serves content. Nominatim confirms the address in the Valletta Valsecchi quarter of Mantova. WebSearch quota exhausted this session, no Italian register lookup was reachable.
